text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I won!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting results. I have defeated both
McQueen
and Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Now, um...
Trainer...

She looks at me with a vaguely lost
expression. I
can't help but worry about
her health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I might run off at any
moment if I
fail to restrain myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps... leap around...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
System controls are not working.
Emergency
maintenance required.

Seeing Mihono Bourbon's panicked
demeanor, I
can't help but burst out
laughing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't understand your reaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Happiness"?
choice_data_list_en: You must be really happy, huh?

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how most people feel happy
when they
win and frustrated when they
lose.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Winning creates "happiness." Losing
creates
"frustration." New knowledge
acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My current state seems to correspond
with
"happiness."

Mihono Bourbon places a hand on her
chest, as if
to physically check her
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Happiness" is comforting. But it's not
just that...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My "desire to win" is also growing at an

exponential rate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I... I want to compete against
even
stronger opponents.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For example... Tokai Teio!

As she is now, Mihono Bourbon could
certainly
rival Tokai Teio.

Tokai Teio's currently recovering from an
injury,
so I try to think of the race she'll
most likely enter
after healing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So that's Mihono Bourbon!

And so, a new battle begins. We put our
all into
daily training once more as we
head for the Japan
Cup!
